items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: He was with us during that period and we played some really rough places.

ctx.x: During this period we played for circuses and carnivals and that is the worst life that anybody could ever - oh, my goodness. I thought about that and I just shivered in bed once because these roustabouts - you call them that? - they are terrible... Doc Cheatham, good trumpeter, did you ever hear of him? He sounded like an [ ]. He was sensational. He was with us during that period and we played some really rough places. That's a terrible life.
When you worked a carnival what did you do for a piano?
